---
name: Feature Request
description: Feature request issue template for proposing a capability, explaining motivation, alternatives, scope, and acceptance criteria.
about: Propose a new capability or enhancement
title: 'feat(<area>): <one-line summary>'
labels: ['enhancement']
---

## Motivation

What problem does this solve? Who's affected? Why now?

## Proposal

What you want to build. Be concrete — interfaces, file layouts, command syntax.

## Alternatives considered

What else could solve this? Why is the proposal better?

## Out of scope

What this proposal explicitly does NOT cover.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Concrete, checkable conditions (no "works well" or "feels right")
- [ ] Tests covering happy path + edge cases
- [ ] Docs updated (CHANGELOG + relevant references)

## Related

- Issues:
- Existing skills/agents/rules this builds on:
